questions.stem: 提示：學校帶全班到附近的消防隊參觀，消防員示範穿裝備，也讓學生練習使用滅火器。請仔細看下面兩張圖片，寫一篇英文作文，文分兩段。第一段比較圖一與圖二兩個活動有什麼不同；第二段寫出你自己參加過的一次防災演練或校外參觀的經驗，並提出一個在家裡防火的簡單計畫及理由。

1.explanation_zh: 這一題有三個要求：第一段比較兩張圖的活動有什麼不同（圖一是消防員示範、學生看和發問；圖二是學生自己動手練習、消防員在旁指導），要寫出差異；第二段寫自己參加過的一次防災演練或校外參觀，再提出一個在家裡防火的簡單計畫並說明理由。計畫要具體，例如檢查滅火器、畫逃生路線。
evidence: 比較圖一與圖二兩個活動有什麼不同
寫出你自己參加過的一次防災演練或校外參觀的經驗
提出一個在家裡防火的簡單計畫及理由
1.strategy_zh: 第一段用 In Picture 1 … In Picture 2, however … 對照「看」與「做」；第二段先用過去式寫經驗，再用 First、Then 列出計畫的步驟，最後用 because 說明理由。
hints: 第一段：In Picture 1, the students are watching … In Picture 2, however, they are …
第二段：Last semester, our school held a fire drill. When the alarm rang, …
計畫：First, I will check … Then I will … because …

moves.zh: 比較圖一與圖二兩個活動有什麼不同
寫出你自己參加過的一次防災演練或校外參觀的經驗
提出一個在家裡防火的簡單計畫及理由

content.focus_zh: 第一段要比較兩張圖的不同（例如學生在看還是在做、消防員在示範還是在指導），不是兩張圖各描述一次；第二段要有一次防災演練或校外參觀的具體經驗，並提出一個在家裡防火的具體計畫（做什麼、怎麼做）與理由。

bands.descriptor_zh: 回應題目的每一項要求，主旨明確；用具體的事例、細節或親身經驗撐起每個重點。
大致回應題目，但有一項要求寫得單薄，或細節偏籠統、說服力不足。
漏掉題目的主要要求或主旨模糊，多數句子空泛、重複或偏離題目。
空白、離題、只抄題目，或內容少到無法判斷要說什麼。

organization.focus_zh: 第一段用 In Picture 1, … In Picture 2, however, … 或 whereas 把兩張圖放在一起對照；第二段由經驗帶出計畫，計畫的步驟可用 First、Then 排列，最後說明理由。

bands.descriptor_zh: 兩段分工清楚，各有主題句；句與句、段與段的銜接自然，轉承語用得恰當，篇幅分配合理。
段落大致分明，但有的地方跳接或重複，轉承語偏少或用得生硬。
重點排列混亂，前後句常接不起來，讀者不容易跟上。
看不出段落與順序，句子彼此無關。

grammar.focus_zh: 圖片用現在進行式，經驗用過去式，計畫用 will 或 plan to＋原形動詞；用 while、whereas 連接的兩個子句都要完整。

bands.descriptor_zh: 句子幾乎沒有文法、標點錯誤，能交替使用簡單句、複句與不同的句首。
偶有時態、單複數或標點錯誤，但讀得懂意思；句型變化有限。
錯誤多到常讓人誤解意思，句子結構常不完整。
幾乎沒有正確的句子，無法理解。

vocabulary.focus_zh: 消防員、消防車、滅火器、頭盔、演練等說法（firefighter、fire truck、fire extinguisher、helmet、fire drill）要拼對；put on（穿上的動作）和 wear（穿著的狀態）要分清楚。

bands.descriptor_zh: 用字精準、貼切，搭配自然，少有重複；拼字與大小寫幾乎全對。
字彙範圍偏窄、常重複同幾個字，偶有用字不當或拼錯，但不妨礙理解。
用錯字或拼錯字很多，常讓人看不懂。
幾乎每個字都用錯或拼錯，無法理解。

rubric.deductions_zh: 字數明顯不足（少於 100 個單詞）或沒有分成兩段，各扣總分 1 分；兩種情形同時發生只扣 1 分。離題或空白以 0 分計。

model_texts.label: steady
model_texts.text:
The two pictures show two activities during a class visit to a fire station. In Picture 1, a firefighter is showing the students how to put on his gear. He is wearing a heavy coat and carrying an air tank, and he is putting on his helmet. Four students are watching him, and one of them is raising a hand to ask a question. In Picture 2, however, the students are not just watching. A girl is using a fire extinguisher to spray a practice board, while a firefighter is pointing at the board and guiding her. Three other students are waiting for their turn. The first activity is about watching, but the second one is about doing.
Last semester, our school held a fire drill. When the alarm rang, we covered our mouths and noses with handkerchiefs. Then we bent down and walked quickly to the playground. After the drill, I realized that I did not know what to do if a fire started at home. Therefore, I have made a simple plan for my family. First, I will check the fire extinguisher in our kitchen. Second, I will draw an escape map of our apartment and put it on the refrigerator. I want to do this because a fire can spread very fast. In conclusion, a little preparation now can keep my family safe.

paragraphs.function_zh: 比較兩張圖：圖一學生看消防員示範，圖二學生自己動手練習

self_assessment.explanation_zh: 第一段比較了兩張圖「看」和「做」的不同，第二段有演練的經驗與兩個步驟的計畫和理由（內容 4）；however、First、Second 使結構清楚，但轉承較基本（組織 4）；時態正確，句型以簡單句為主（文法句構 4）；extinguisher、escape 拼寫正確，但整體多是常用字（字彙拼字 3）。總分 15，屬穩健版。

model_texts.label: top
model_texts.text:
Although both pictures show the same visit to a fire station, they present two very different ways of learning. In Picture 1, the students are spectators. A firefighter, already dressed in a thick protective coat with an air tank strapped to his back, is pulling his helmet into place, demonstrating how quickly he must get ready when an alarm sounds. Four students are standing in a row nearby, watching every move, and one of them is raising a hand, eager to ask a question. In Picture 2, by contrast, the students have become the ones in action. A girl is aiming a fire extinguisher at a practice board painted with flames, while a firefighter beside her is pointing at the target and coaching her through each step. Behind them, three classmates are waiting in line for their turn. Whereas the first scene builds knowledge through watching, the second builds confidence through doing.
Last spring, my school held a fire drill without telling us the exact time, and it showed me how unprepared I was. When the alarm suddenly rang during math class, several classmates froze, and one boy even started packing his schoolbag. Our teacher had to remind us to cover our mouths and noses, keep low, and leave everything behind. It took us four minutes to evacuate to the playground, one minute longer than the school's goal. On the way home that day, I began to wonder whether my family would do any better, and honestly, I doubted it. As a result, I have made a simple plan for our apartment. First, I will check whether our fire extinguisher still works and show my parents and younger brother how to use it, just as the firefighter in Picture 2 is doing. Then I will draw an escape map with two exits and stick it on the refrigerator so that everyone can see it every day. Finally, I hope to hold a short family drill every three months. Some people may think such precautions are unnecessary because fires are rare. However, the drill at school showed me that panic, not fire, is often the first danger. All in all, a plan practiced in advance is the simplest way to keep my family calm and safe.

paragraphs.function_zh: 比較兩張圖：從學生的角色、消防員的做法寫出「看」與「做」的差別，最後用 whereas 總結

notes.zh: 讓步：同一次參觀卻有不同的學習方式
同時：女生噴、消防員指導
轉折：反駁不必準備的看法

notes.text: A firefighter, already dressed in a thick protective coat with an air tank strapped to his back, is pulling his helmet into place, demonstrating how quickly he must get ready when an alarm sounds.
A girl is aiming a fire extinguisher at a practice board painted with flames, while a firefighter beside her is pointing at the target and coaching her through each step.
When the alarm suddenly rang during math class, several classmates froze, and one boy even started packing his schoolbag.
It took us four minutes to evacuate to the playground, one minute longer than the school's goal.
Whereas the first scene builds knowledge through watching, the second builds confidence through doing.
notes.zh: whereas 對照兩個子句，句型平行

notes.text: panic, not fire, is often the first danger
notes.zh: A, not B, …：強調真正的重點

notes.text: It took us four minutes to evacuate
notes.zh: It takes＋人＋時間＋to V：花多少時間做…

self_assessment.explanation_zh: 比較從學生角色到消防員的做法都有對照，經驗段有具體細節與數字，計畫有三個步驟，並回應反對意見後提出見解（內容 5）；by contrast、Whereas、As a result、All in all 使比較與計畫層次分明（組織 5）；分詞片語、whereas 子句、so that、A, not B 等句型正確多樣（文法句構 5）；demonstrating、unprepared、panic 用得精確，但整體以常用字為主（字彙拼字 4）。總分 19，屬頂標版。

steady.comment_zh: 第一段以 In Picture 1 … In Picture 2, however 對照，並以 watching／doing 總結差異，put on 與 wearing 分得清楚；第二段有學校防火演練的經驗，計畫（檢查滅火器、畫逃生圖）具體並說明理由。全文無錯，但演練經驗偏一般敘述，句型變化有限。

top.comment_zh: 第一段以 spectators／in action 與 Whereas 句明確比較兩圖，不是各描述一次；第二段演練經驗具體（同學愣住、多花一分鐘），自然帶出三步驟的家庭計畫，再以反方意見與 panic, not fire 說明理由。句型多變、用字精準，無錯誤。計畫偏向火災應變（逃生圖、家庭演練），但含檢查滅火器，仍回應防火要求。

steady.comment_zh: 第一段用 In Picture 1 ... In Picture 2, however ... 對照「看」與「做」，並以一句總結差異，確實是比較而非各自描述；第二段有火災演習的經驗（用手帕摀口鼻、彎腰快走），再提出檢查滅火器與畫逃生圖兩步驟並說明理由（火勢蔓延快）。文法正確、時態恰當；經驗與比較的細節中等，用字（air tank、fire extinguisher、escape map）準確。

top.comment_zh: 第一段以 spectators 與 in action 對比兩張圖，用 by contrast、Whereas 收束成「知識」對「信心」，比較深入；第二段有突擊演習、四分鐘撤離、同學愣住等具體經驗，計畫用 First、Then、Finally 排出三個步驟，並以「恐慌才是第一個危險」回應質疑，理由有說服力。句型複雜度高且無文法、標點錯誤；put on／wear 的區分、dressed in 等用字精準。
